title: From TV Animation Slam Dunk: I Love Basketball
native_title: テレビアニメ スラム・ダンク ～アイ・ラブ・バスケットボール～
overview:
Pursue the appeal of the court, and you arrive at this game. Basketball is the King of Sports!!

Based on the TV anime Slam Dunk, this fast-paced action basketball game puts Hanamichi Sakuragi of Shohoku and the high school players of the series on the court. Hand-drawn players race across a textured polygon 3D court, with the camera angle changing whenever possession of the ball changes hands.

- Story mode
- Head-to-head matches for 1 or 2 players
- Memory backup support

コートの上の魅力を追求すると、このゲームにたどりつく。バスケットボールはKing of Sportsだ!!
